programmes.d: Nancy and her children suffer from a lack of funds in the household. Celia confronts her husband's mistress.
While a mountain lion terrorizes the town of Agrestic, a medical marijuana facility does the same to Nancy.
Andy, Nancy's brother in-law, causes major problems with his surprise visit. Celia reveals she has cancer.
Shane has problems at school again. Celia tries to get rid of her cancer in a non-conventional way.
Nancy, Conrad and Celia go out to a club and things heat up between Conrad and Celia.
Nancy takes a risk by recruiting Silas' tutor and friends to sell pot for her on his community college campus.
With Nancy gone, Andy and Doug get into her stash and make a mess in stoned pursuit of a rat in the wall.
Nancy gets "busted" selling pot, but ends up receiving retribution and protection from an anonymous source.
Nancy gathers a team to go into business with Conrad circumventing Heylia, who has become a grandmother.
An overturned bus makes for a crazy day and Eddie gets his job back - all on the day before Jackie's birthday.
Jackie and Kevin are at a stalemate in their divorce mediation because Kevin wants full custody.
After their custody meeting, Jackie rear-ends Kevin. Kevin accuses her of using.
A heavily medicated Jane Doe is brought into the ER and Jackie tasks Zoey with finding out who she is.
Jackie is nervous about her date, so Zoey and Thor help her get ready and Eddie offers some friendly pointers.
